verdict.rationale: ClickHouse's own Incremental Materialized Views run computation automatically at insert time. That is effectively a SQL-defined rule that fires on insert events, but the docs frame it as query acceleration rather than general event-driven action automation. missing for 10: documented general-purpose event rules or triggers, actions beyond in-database transforms (e.g., external calls or alerts), event types other than inserts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Incremental Materialized Views (Materialized Views) allow you to shift the cost of computation from query time to insert time, resulting in faster SELECT queries.
